openai/gpt-5.6-sol.title: Clock sampling reuses stale timestamps for eight reads, allowing expired entries to be returned
Eviction pops the most recently used entry instead of the least recently used entry
Key lookup records an expired entry as a hit instead of a miss
Handle lookup never compares generations, so pre-clear handles resolve reinserted keys
Every eviction appends a tombstone that normal cache operations never drain
Adding the TTL to the current time can overflow, causing a panic or an incorrect expiration deadline
